title: Vampire Vape Koncept Blood Sukka 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Blood Sukka from Vampire Vape is a deliciously complex and utterly moreish e-liquid with bags of character. It’s a juice that throws a lot of flavours into the mix, but from your very first taste you’ll understand that this is a supremely well-crafted e-liquid. Rich, juicy cherries are layered with sweet, tangy berries, followed by a dash of spice from aniseed. Vampire Vape’s new Koncept range brings more 100ml shortfills to their celebrated collection, offering sub-ohm vapers significantly longer-lasting versions of some of Vampire Vape’s most iconic e-liquids. All your favourites are here, including such legendary juices as Pinkman and Heisenberg. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your e juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. These shortfill e-liquids contain a ratio of 70VG/30PG which make them essential for use with higher-powered vape kits and pod kits, as most of these devices will use a coil below 1.0ohm (sub-ohm) resistance. At lower resistances coils are better equipped to handle the thicker VG ingredient of the e-liquid, and produce satisfying, dense clouds and fantastic flavour.
